senses.gloss: f. (an adapt. of capsa, as if from קָפַץ) chest, box.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:7">Kel. XVI, 7</cite> ed. Dehr. (ed. <cite ref="S00518"><he>קופסא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:1:7">Y. Nidd. II, beg. 49ᵈ</cite> <he>ק׳ של זכוכית</he> a glass box.—Pl. <he>קַפְצָיוֹת</he>.
